games.name: 📉 Cart ride to save canny cat [PONZI SCHEMES!]
games.desc:
a remake for crtscc is in the works, stay tuned

Core mechanics inspired by "Cart ride around a 75kw diesel generator". it should be in similar experiences go check it out too

The evil 🐈‍⬛ uncanny cats have kidnapped 🐈 canny cat and put him at the end of a perilous cart ride. Grab a cart and go save your kitty!

Controls/Tips:

CTRL to shiftlock
LMB or DOUBLE TAP to pick up unanchored part (such as a cart)
SHIFT + WASDQE or ROTATE BUTTON + JOYSTICK to rotate currently held part

To start the game, pick up a cart and place it on the rails, then click the green button to start the cart. Make sure to look out for traps along the way! 
Remember that if your cart derails, you can jump out and drag it back into place. 

Building and electrical signals in this game can be confusing at first. Just remember that only parts which are glued together will transfer signals, and don't be afraid to ask experienced players for help. 

Have fun! 💥💥💥

games.name: The Robloxia: Until Dawn
games.desc:
THIS GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS

Welcome to The Robloxia: Until Dawn, a game that tries to turn popular classic roblox myths and etc. all together into a survival game, team up with with 5 more survivors against different killers and try to escape their grip, or play as them and eliminate everyone on sight before the portal spawns.

Took concepts, soundtracks and inspiration from:
- Sonic.EXE: The Disaster (RIP)
- Sonic.EXE: Spectral Fades
- Left4Dead2
- Mob of the dead

Some soundtracks are used without permission as said composers were quite hard to contact, if you own a soundtrack that is used in the game and can prove that it is made by you then please join our community server and contact me there, it will be replaced if needed. All credits are in the game.

I do not own any licenses of any un-official/original soundtracks used in the game, nor any rights to anything else. This is just a passion project for fun

Originally made on February 10th 2023
